setting up plotting theme: 
```{r}
{r}
fontsize <- 14
linesize <- .5
barcolors <- c("#f76c67","#67aaf7","#0bca81","#f6a84f","#9c67f7","#67f7f0","#7F7F7F")

my_theme <- function() {
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size=fontsize, margin=margin(0,0,20,0)),
        axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", size = 1), 
        axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", size = 1),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = .8*fontsize, hjust=1, vjust=1, angle = 45),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = .8*fontsize), 
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 1*fontsize),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        legend.position="none", 
        strip.text.x = element_text(size=fontsize), 
        text = element_text(family="Helvetica")) # +
  # theme(plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "cm"))
}
```

```{r}
nina_behav <- nina_behav %>%
  filter(period=="recall")

behav$eventDet = nina_behav$eventDetails.y # adding nina's add'l coding 
behav$visualDet = nina_behav$visualDetails.y


# add in missing data from nina's coding 
missing = read.csv('/Volumes/memolab/Data/Behavioral_Online/reframe-details/detail_script_files/missing_coded.csv')
behav <- behav %>%
  left_join(missing, by = c("subID", "videoName"))
behav$eventDets = ifelse(is.na(behav$eventDet.x), behav$eventDet.y, behav$eventDet.x)
behav$visualDets = ifelse(is.na(behav$visualDet.x), behav$visualDet.y, behav$visualDet.x)

# remove unnecessary columns 
behav = behav %>% select(-eventDet.x, -visualDet.x, -eventDet.y, -visualDet.y)


table(behav$subID,behav$run)
nsub.behav <- length(unique(behav$subID))

# Some video info is contained only for the first round. Make sure it's repeated for other rounds. 
behav.roundone <- behav %>% 
  filter(regRound==1) %>%
  select("subID","videoName","recallValence","recallArousal","recallVividness",
         "encValence","encArousal","valenceChange","arousalChange","successful",
         "remembered","correctDetails", "eventDets", "visualDets")
behav.left <- behav[,1:18]

behav.all <- full_join(behav.left,behav.roundone,by=c("subID","videoName"),
                       suffix=c("",".ignore"))


# no event/visual detail column should have "NA" - replace with zero. 

behav.all$eventDets = ifelse(is.na(behav.all$eventDets), 0, behav.all$eventDets)
behav.all$visualDets = ifelse(is.na(behav.all$visualDets), 0, behav.all$visualDets)
```

# Clean up / set up 


### define factors 
```{r}
alldata$ROI <- as.factor(alldata$ROI)
alldata$conditionName <- as.factor(alldata$conditionName)
alldata$valenceCategory <- as.factor(alldata$valenceCategory)
alldata$subID <- as.factor(alldata$subID)
alldata$regRound.categ <- as.factor(alldata$regRound) # keep both integer & categorical versions
alldata$videoName <- as.factor(alldata$videoName)
alldata$periodLabel <- as.factor(alldata$periodLabel)
```

### remove outliers

```{r}
### add z score of activity estimates within region and subject and time-period
alldata <- alldata %>%
  group_by(subID, ROI, periodLabel) %>%
  mutate(Z = zscore(regulationActivity)) %>%
  ungroup()

# remove betas that are > 4SD 
tmp <- alldata %>%
  mutate(isOutlier = ifelse(abs(Z)>4,TRUE,FALSE))

# Following Cooper & Ritchey, remove trials where mean for ANY ROI is an outlier
outliers <- tmp %>%
  select(isOutlier,subID,trial) %>%
  filter(isOutlier) %>%
  unique()
alldata <- left_join(alldata,outliers,by=c("subID","trial"))
alldata$isOutlier[is.na(alldata$isOutlier)] <- FALSE

# Summarize number of outliers
table(alldata$subID,alldata$isOutlier)
table(alldata$isOutlier)

alldata$regulationActivity[alldata$isOutlier] <- NA  #mark value as NA if outlier
```



### set up trial filters
Include trials with success ratings greater than zero - Use successful==1 (video level rating, see ms) or regSuccess>=1 (trial level rating)

Include trials that were remembered during delayed recall - Use remembered==1

Include trials only for remember, not reappraise - Use conditionName == "remember"

```{r}
alldata <- alldata %>%
  mutate(isComplete.emo = ifelse(is.na(valenceChange) | is.na(arousalChange),
                             FALSE,TRUE))

# Removing negative reappraisal trials
alldata <- alldata %>%
  filter(conditionName == "remember")


all_nr = alldata # capturing all trials, not just remembered 
 alldata <- alldata %>% filter(remembered == 1) # IF UNCOMMENTED, ONLY LOOKING AT REMEMBERED TRIALS. 
```

## Set up function for running model 

```{r}
detail_emo_neuref <- function(curROI, model.stats) {

  # subset data for this ROI
  roiData <- roi.data %>% filter(as.character(ROI) == curROI)
  
  # skip if there’s no data
  if (nrow(roiData) == 0) {
    message("Skipping ROI: ", curROI, " (no data)")
    return(model.stats)  # just return the existing stats
  }
  
  roiData$valenceCategory <- factor(roiData$valenceCategory, levels=c("neu", "neg", "pos"))
  
  # fit model
  full.model <- lmer(regulationActivity ~ visualDets + eventDets +
                       visualDets*valenceCategory + eventDets*valenceCategory +
                       (1|subID), data = roiData)
  
  # extract stats
  stats <- data.frame(summary(full.model)$coefficients[2:nrow(summary(full.model)$coefficients),])
  stats <- mutate(stats, ROI=curROI)
  model.stats <- rbind(model.stats, stats)
  
  return(model.stats)
}

```

## loop over all ROIs to run the model 

```{r}
model.stats <- data.frame(
  term = character(),
  estimate = numeric(),
  std.error = numeric(),
  statistic = numeric(),
  p.value = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

rois <- levels(alldata$ROI)   # all ROIs in the df 

for (r in rois) {
  model.stats <- detail_emo_neuref(r, model.stats)
}

# move the row names of model.stats into a proper column - causing errors if you don't
if (is.null(model.stats$term)) {
  model.stats <- model.stats %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "term")
}
```


# FDR-corrected results 


## narrative details 
```{r}
# Select all eventDets rows
event.model <- model.stats %>%
  filter(grepl("^eventDets[0-9]*$", term))   # ^ matches "eventDets", "eventDets1", ..., "eventDets41"


# FDR correction
p.values <- event.model[,6] # p-value column is in column 6
event.model$Pr.fdr <- p.adjust(p.values, method = "fdr")
event.model <- event.model %>%
  mutate(sig = Pr.fdr < 0.05)

# display table below 
kbl(event.model, digits = 3) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) %>%
  scroll_box(width = "1200px", height = "800px")

```

## tables 

```{r}
# Combine all post-FDR data frames with appropriate labels 
all_models <- bind_rows(
  event.model %>% mutate(model_name = "Narrative details"),
  visual.model %>% mutate(model_name = "Perceptual details"),
  pos.model %>% mutate(model_name = "Positive valence"),
  neg.model %>% mutate(model_name = "Negative valence"),
  event.pos.model %>% mutate(model_name = "Narrative details × Positive valence"),
  event.neg.model %>% mutate(model_name = "Narrative details × Negative valence"),
  vis.pos.model %>% mutate(model_name = "Perceptual details × Positive valence"),
  vis.neg.model %>% mutate(model_name = "Perceptual details × Negative valence")
)

# Filter to only significant results
sig_results <- all_models %>%
  filter(sig == TRUE) %>%
  arrange(model_name, ROI)

# Display nicely
kbl(sig_results, digits = 3) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) %>%
  scroll_box(width = "1200px", height = "800px")

#  Clean and format for display 
rsa_table_clean <- sig_results %>%
  select(model_name, ROI, Estimate, df, t.value, Pr.fdr) %>%
  
  # Round numeric columns
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(., 3))) %>%
  
  # --- Split ROI into components ---
  separate(ROI, into = c("Hemisphere", "Network", "Region label"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") %>%
  select(term = model_name, Network, `Region label`, Hemi = Hemisphere, Estimate, df, t.value, Pr.fdr) %>%
  
  # --- Sort and group for readability ---
  mutate(is_interaction = grepl("×", term)) %>%
  arrange(is_interaction, term, Network, `Region label`, Hemi) %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  mutate(term_label = ifelse(row_number() == 1, term, "")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # --- Format p-values ---
  mutate(
    Pr.fdr = case_when(
      Pr.fdr < 0.001 ~ "p < .001",
      Pr.fdr < 0.01  ~ "p < .01",
      Pr.fdr < 0.05  ~ "p < .05",
      TRUE           ~ as.character(signif(Pr.fdr, 3))
    )
  )

# --- Display in console ---
kable(
  rsa_table_clean[, c("term_label", "Network", "Region label", "Hemi", "Estimate", "df", "t.value", "Pr.fdr")],
  col.names = c("Term", "Network", "Region label", "Hemi", "Estimate", "df", "t", "p (FDR)"),
  digits = 3,
  format = "simple"
)

# --- Export to Word (nice formatted table) ---
table_for_word <- rsa_table_clean %>%
  select(
    Term = term_label,
    Network,
    `Region label`,
    Hemi,
    Estimate,
    df,
    t = t.value,
    `p (FDR)` = Pr.fdr
  )

ft <- flextable(table_for_word) %>%
  autofit() %>%
  theme_vanilla() %>%
  align(j = c("Estimate", "df", "t", "p (FDR)"), align = "center", part = "all")

doc <- read_docx() |> 
  body_add_par("Activity Results: Whole Brain", style = "heading 1") |> 
  body_add_flextable(ft)

print(doc, target = "Activity_results_table_wholebrain.docx")

# --- Optional: restrict to DMN only ---
rsa_table_dmn <- rsa_table_clean %>%
  filter(Network %in% c("DefaultA", "DefaultB", "DefaultC")) %>%
  # Re-create term_label after filtering
  select(-term_label) %>%
  arrange(is_interaction, term, Network, `Region label`, Hemi) %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  mutate(term_label = ifelse(row_number() == 1, term, "")) %>%
  ungroup()

ft_dmn <- flextable(rsa_table_dmn %>%
  select(Term = term_label, Network, `Region label`, Hemi, Estimate, df, t = t.value, `p (FDR)` = Pr.fdr)) %>%
  autofit()

doc_dmn <- read_docx() |> 
  body_add_par("Activity Results: DMN Only", style = "heading 1") |> 
  body_add_flextable(ft_dmn)

print(doc_dmn, target = "Activity_results_table_DMN_only.docx")


```

further table formatting
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(tidyr)

df <- read.csv("/Users/ninacurko/Downloads/my_exported_table.csv")


df_clean <- df %>%
  select(term, ROI, Estimate, df, t.value, Pr.fdr) %>%
  
  # Round numeric columns to 3 significant figures
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(., 3))) %>%
  
  # --- Clean up term names ---
  mutate(
    term = sub("[0-9]+$", "", term),
    term = gsub("eventDets", "Narrative details", term),
    term = gsub("visualDets", "Perceptual details", term),
    term = gsub("valenceCategorypos", "Positive valence", term),
    term = gsub("valenceCategoryneg", "Negative valence", term),
    term = gsub(":", " × ", term)
  ) %>%
  
  # --- Split ROI ---
  separate(ROI, into = c("Hemisphere", "Network", "Region label"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") %>%
  
  # Move Hemisphere last and rename it
  select(term, Network, `Region label`, Hemi = Hemisphere, Estimate, df, t.value, Pr.fdr) %>%
  
  # Sort: main effects first, then interactions
  mutate(is_interaction = grepl("×", term)) %>%
  arrange(is_interaction, term, Network, `Region label`, Hemi) %>%
  
  # Label term only once per group
  group_by(term) %>%
  mutate(term_label = ifelse(row_number() == 1, term, "")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # --- Recode p-values ---
  mutate(
    Pr.fdr = case_when(
      Pr.fdr < 0.001 ~ "p < .001",
      Pr.fdr < 0.01  ~ "p < .01",
      Pr.fdr < 0.05  ~ "p < .05",
      TRUE           ~ as.character(signif(Pr.fdr, 3))
    )
  )

# --- Print table ---
kable(
  df_clean[, c("term_label", "Network", "Region label", "Hemi", "Estimate", "df", "t.value", "Pr.fdr")],
  col.names = c("Term", "Network", "Region label", "Hemi", "Estimate", "df", "t", "p (FDR)"),
  digits = 3,
  format = "simple"
)


library(flextable)
library(officer)

# make a data frame version of  clean table
table_for_word <- df_clean %>%
  select(Term = term_label,
         Network,
         `Region label`,
         Hemi,
         Estimate,
         df,
         t = t.value,
         `p (FDR)` = Pr.fdr)

# create a flextable
ft <- flextable(table_for_word)
ft <- autofit(ft)

# export to Word
doc <- read_docx() |>
  body_add_flextable(ft)
print(doc, target = "regression_table.docx")

```

# Within vs between parcels 
##  Within vs Between t-test 


```{r}

# Assign network labels to ROIs
roi.data.sim <- roi.data %>%
  mutate(network = case_when(
    grepl("DefaultA", ROI) ~ "DMN A",
    grepl("DefaultB", ROI) ~ "DMN B",
    grepl("DefaultC", ROI) ~ "DMN C",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))

# Pivot to wide format: rows = trials, columns = ROIs
roi_matrix <- roi.data.sim %>%
  select(subID, trial, ROI, regulationActivity) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = ROI, values_from = regulationActivity)

roi_names <- sort(unique(roi.data.sim$ROI))
message("Number of canonical ROIs: ", length(roi_names))


#COMPUTE ROI-ROI CORRELATIONS BY SUBJECT

subs <- split(roi_matrix, roi_matrix$subID)

roi_corrs_list <- lapply(names(subs), function(sid) {
  df <- subs[[sid]]
  roi_cols <- intersect(colnames(df), roi_names)
  
  if (length(roi_cols) < 2) return(NULL)
  
  mat <- df[, roi_cols, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Remove all-NA columns
  all_na_cols <- which(vapply(mat, function(x) all(is.na(x)), logical(1)))
  if (length(all_na_cols) > 0) {
    mat <- mat[, -all_na_cols, drop = FALSE]
  }
  
  if (ncol(mat) < 2 || nrow(mat) < 2) return(NULL)
  
  # Compute correlation matrix
  corr <- cor(mat, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  
  tibble(
    subID = sid,
    ROI1 = rep(colnames(corr), each = ncol(corr)),
    ROI2 = rep(colnames(corr), times = ncol(corr)),
    corr = as.vector(corr)
  )
})

roi_corrs <- bind_rows(roi_corrs_list)
cat("Subjects processed:", length(roi_corrs_list), "\n")


# ADD NETWORK LABELS AND FILTER

roi_corrs <- roi_corrs %>%
  # Add network labels for both ROIs
  left_join(
    roi.data.sim %>% distinct(ROI, network),
    by = c("ROI1" = "ROI")
  ) %>%
  rename(net1 = network) %>%
  left_join(
    roi.data.sim %>% distinct(ROI, network),
    by = c("ROI2" = "ROI")
  ) %>%
  rename(net2 = network) %>%
  # Keep only DMN pairs
  filter(net1 != "Other", net2 != "Other") %>%
  # Remove self-correlations
  filter(ROI1 != ROI2) %>%
  # Keep each unique pair only once
  filter(ROI1 < ROI2) %>%
  # Define within vs between
  mutate(
    pair_type = ifelse(net1 == net2, "within", "between"),
    # Fisher z-transform
    z_corr = atanh(corr)
  )

cat("Total ROI pairs:", nrow(roi_corrs), "\n")


# DIAGNOSTIC CHECKS
cat("\n=== DIAGNOSTIC CHECKS ===\n")

# 1. Network assignments
cat("\n1. Network assignment:\n")
roi.data.sim %>% 
  distinct(ROI, network) %>% 
  count(network) %>%
  print()

# 2. Pair type breakdown
cat("\n2. Correlation pairs by type:\n")
roi_corrs %>% 
  count(pair_type) %>%
  print()

# 3. Check each subject has both types
cat("\n3. Subject-level pair availability:\n")
subject_check <- roi_corrs %>%
  group_by(subID) %>%
  summarise(
    has_within = any(pair_type == "within"),
    has_between = any(pair_type == "between"),
    n_within = sum(pair_type == "within"),
    n_between = sum(pair_type == "between")
  )

cat("Subjects with BOTH within and between pairs:", 
    sum(subject_check$has_within & subject_check$has_between), "\n")
cat("Subjects with ONLY within pairs:", 
    sum(subject_check$has_within & !subject_check$has_between), "\n")
cat("Subjects with ONLY between pairs:", 
    sum(!subject_check$has_within & subject_check$has_between), "\n")

# 4. Distribution check
cat("\n4. Correlation distributions:\n")
roi_corrs %>% 
  group_by(pair_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_pairs = n(),
    n_subjects = n_distinct(subID),
    mean_r = mean(corr, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_r = sd(corr, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_z = mean(z_corr, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_z = sd(z_corr, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  print()


# SUBJECT-LEVEL AGGREGATION FOR T-TEST


# Average Fisher z-transformed correlations within each subject and pair type
subject_avg <- roi_corrs %>%
  group_by(subID, pair_type) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_z = mean(z_corr, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_pairs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Pivot to wide format for paired t-test
subject_wide <- subject_avg %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = subID,
    names_from = pair_type,
    values_from = mean_z
  )

cat("\n=== SUBJECT-LEVEL DATA FOR T-TEST ===\n")
cat("Subjects with complete data (both within and between):", 
    sum(!is.na(subject_wide$within) & !is.na(subject_wide$between)), "\n")
cat("Subjects missing within data:", sum(is.na(subject_wide$within)), "\n")
cat("Subjects missing between data:", sum(is.na(subject_wide$between)), "\n")


# PAIRED T-TEST: WITHIN vs BETWEEN

cat("\n=== PAIRED T-TEST RESULTS ===\n")

# Remove subjects with missing data in either condition
subject_complete <- subject_wide %>%
  filter(!is.na(within) & !is.na(between))

cat("N subjects in analysis:", nrow(subject_complete), "\n\n")

# Descriptive statistics
cat("Descriptive statistics (Fisher z):\n")
cat("Within-network:  M =", round(mean(subject_complete$within), 3), 
    ", SD =", round(sd(subject_complete$within), 3), "\n")
cat("Between-network: M =", round(mean(subject_complete$between), 3), 
    ", SD =", round(sd(subject_complete$between), 3), "\n")
cat("Difference:      M =", round(mean(subject_complete$within - subject_complete$between), 3), 
    ", SD =", round(sd(subject_complete$within - subject_complete$between), 3), "\n\n")

# Convert back to r for interpretation
cat("Descriptive statistics (Pearson r):\n")
cat("Within-network:  M =", round(tanh(mean(subject_complete$within)), 3), "\n")
cat("Between-network: M =", round(tanh(mean(subject_complete$between)), 3), "\n\n")

# Paired t-test
ttest_result <- t.test(
  subject_complete$within, 
  subject_complete$between, 
  paired = TRUE,
  alternative = "two.sided"
)

print(ttest_result)

# Effect size (Cohen's d for paired samples)
diff <- subject_complete$within - subject_complete$between
cohens_d <- mean(diff) / sd(diff)
cat("\nCohen's d =", round(cohens_d, 3), "\n")


# 6. SAVE SUBJECT-LEVEL SUMMARY

# Add difference score for plotting
subject_summary <- subject_complete %>%
  mutate(
    difference = within - between,
    within_r = tanh(within),
    between_r = tanh(between)
  )

cat("Variables preserved for later use:\n")
cat("- roi.data.sim: original data with network labels\n")
cat("- roi_corrs: all pairwise correlations with network info\n")
cat("- subject_summary: subject-level averages for plotting\n")
```

```{r}
# create ROI name lookup (no "Other" network)
roi_name_lookup <- roi.data.sim %>%
  distinct(ROI, network) %>%
  filter(network != "Other")

# calculate group-level correlations from roi_corrs
roi_corrs_group <- roi_corrs %>%
  filter(net1 != "Other", net2 != "Other") %>%
  group_by(ROI1, ROI2, net1, net2) %>%
  summarise(mean_z = mean(z_corr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# mirror the matrix to fill both triangles
roi_corrs_mirror <- roi_corrs_group %>%
  rename(ROI1_temp = ROI1, ROI2_temp = ROI2,
         net1_temp = net1, net2_temp = net2) %>%
  rename(ROI1 = ROI2_temp, ROI2 = ROI1_temp,
         net1 = net2_temp, net2 = net1_temp)

# add diagonal with NA so that it is gray 
all_dmn_rois <- roi_name_lookup$ROI
roi_corrs_diagonal <- tibble(
  ROI1 = all_dmn_rois,
  ROI2 = all_dmn_rois,
  net1 = roi_name_lookup$network,
  net2 = roi_name_lookup$network,
  mean_z = NA_real_  # NA for diagonal - will be gray
)

# combine all
roi_corrs_full <- bind_rows(roi_corrs_group, roi_corrs_mirror, roi_corrs_diagonal)

# create shortened names
roi_corrs_full <- roi_corrs_full %>%
  mutate(
    ROI1_short = str_replace(ROI1, "Default", ""),
    ROI2_short = str_replace(ROI2, "Default", "")
  )

# order ROIs by network

  mutate(ROI_short = str_replace(ROI, "Default", "")) %>%
  arrange(factor(network, levels = c("DMN A", "DMN B", "DMN C"))) %>%
  pull(ROI_short)

# apply factor ordering
roi_corrs_full$ROI1_short <- factor(roi_corrs_full$ROI1_short, levels = roi_order_short)
roi_corrs_full$ROI2_short <- factor(roi_corrs_full$ROI2_short, levels = roi_order_short)

# calculate network boundaries
network_boundaries <- roi_name_lookup %>%
  mutate(network_label = recode(network,
                                "DMN A" = "Core",
                                "DMN B" = "DM",
                                "DMN C" = "MT")) %>%
  arrange(factor(network, levels = c("DMN A", "DMN B", "DMN C"))) %>%
  group_by(network_label) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    cum_n = cumsum(n),
    start = cum_n - n + 1,
    mid = start + (n - 1) / 2
  )

boundary_lines <- network_boundaries$cum_n[-nrow(network_boundaries)] + 0.5

# create correlation matrix plot
```

# Plot whole brains  (possibly add t code from earlier)


## setup 

create plot_brain helper function for plotting brains 
```{r}
library(ggseg)
library(ggsegSchaefer)
library(patchwork) 

# Load the Schaefer atlas 
atlas <- as_tibble(schaefer17_200)  # 17 networks, 200 cortical parcels

# Function to plot brain results
plot_brain <- function(atlas_data, side, symmetric = TRUE, threshold = FALSE) {
  
  # Find min and max values for color scale
  minval <- min(atlas_data$t_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  maxval <- max(atlas_data$t_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Make scale symmetric if needed
  if (symmetric) {
    if (abs(minval) > abs(maxval) & minval < 0 & maxval > 0) {
      maxval <- -1 * minval
    }
    if (abs(maxval) > abs(minval) & minval < 0 & maxval > 0) {
      minval <- -1 * maxval
    }
  }
  
  # Threshold non-significant values
  if (threshold) {
    atlas_data$t_value[atlas_data$sig == FALSE] <- NA
  }
  
  # Set NA sig to FALSE
  atlas_data$sig[is.na(atlas_data$sig)] <- FALSE
  
  # Create the plot 
  p <- ggplot() + 
    geom_brain(
      atlas = atlas_data,
      mapping = aes(fill = t_value, color=sig),
      position = position_brain(position = 'horizontal'),
      hemi = side,
      size = .5,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      limits = c(minval, maxval),
      na.value = "grey80",
      low = "#2166ac",
      mid = "white",
      high = "#b2182b",
      midpoint = 0
    ) + 
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "black", "FALSE" = NA), guide = "none")

  
  return(p)
}
```


define t-plot function, needed for supplement plots 

```{r}

# Purpose: Creates t-value scatter plot for DMN ROIs only
make_effect_plot_pub_univariate <- function(model_df, title = NULL) {
  
  # Relabel networks to match publication style
  plot_data <- model_df %>%
    mutate(
      network = case_when(
        grepl("DefaultA", ROI) ~ "Core midline",
        grepl("DefaultB", ROI) ~ "Dorsomedial",
        grepl("DefaultC", ROI) ~ "Medial temporal",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      ROI_clean = case_when(
        grepl("HIPP", ROI) ~ ROI,
        grepl("AMYG", ROI) ~ ROI,
        TRUE ~ ROI %>%
          gsub("^LH_|^RH_", "", .) %>%
          gsub("DefaultA_|DefaultB_|DefaultC_", "", .)
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(network != "Other")
  
  # Create plot with consistent formatting
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = network, y = t.value)) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = network, fill = ifelse(sig, network, "white")),
      shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = ROI_clean, color = network),
      hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, nudge_x = 0.05, size = 2.5
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgray", size = 0.5) + 
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("white" = "white", 
                 "Core midline" = "slateblue1", 
                 "Dorsomedial" = "lightsteelblue3", 
                 "Medial temporal" = "slateblue4")
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Core midline" = "slateblue1", 
                 "Dorsomedial" = "lightsteelblue3", 
                 "Medial temporal" = "slateblue4")
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Activity (t-value)") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5), 
      axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5), 
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8), 
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "cm")
    )
  
  # Add title only if provided
  if (!is.null(title)) {
    p <- p + labs(title = title) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10))
  }
  
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
# create plot without a legend 
create_left_brain_no_legend <- function(model_data) {
  
  # Prepare brain data
  atlas <- as_tibble(schaefer17_200)
  
  plotvals <- model_data %>%
    filter(!ROI %in% c("LH_HIPP", "RH_HIPP", "LH_AMYG", "RH_AMYG")) %>%
    select(ROI, t_value = t.value, sig) %>%
    mutate(region = paste0('17Networks_', ROI)) %>%
    select(region, t_value, sig) %>%
    distinct(region, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  atlas_data <- left_join(atlas, plotvals, by = "region")
  
  # Get min/max for symmetric scale
  minval <- min(atlas_data$t_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  maxval <- max(atlas_data$t_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (abs(minval) > abs(maxval) & minval < 0 & maxval > 0) {
    maxval <- -1 * minval
  }
  if (abs(maxval) > abs(minval) & minval < 0 & maxval > 0) {
    minval <- -1 * maxval
  }
  
  # Set NA sig to FALSE
  atlas_data$sig[is.na(atlas_data$sig)] <- FALSE
  
  # Create left brain plot WITHOUT LEGEND
  brain_plot <- ggplot() + 
    geom_brain(
      atlas = atlas_data,
      mapping = aes(fill = t_value, color = sig),
      position = position_brain(position = 'horizontal'),
      hemi = "left",
      size = 0.5,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      limits = c(minval, maxval),
      na.value = "grey80",
      low = "#2166ac",
      mid = "white",
      high = "#b2182b",
      midpoint = 0
    ) + 
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(`TRUE` = "black", `FALSE` = NA), 
      guide = "none"
    )
  
  return(brain_plot)
  
}
  
# create a legend 
  create_standalone_legend <- function(minval = -4, maxval = 4) {
  
  # Create a dummy dataset for the legend
  legend_data <- data.frame(
    x = 1,
    y = seq(minval, maxval, length.out = 100)
  )
  
  legend_plot <- ggplot(legend_data, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = y)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#2166ac",
      mid = "white",
      high = "#b2182b",
      midpoint = 0,
      name = "t-value",
      limits = c(minval, maxval)
    ) +
    theme_void(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key.height = unit(1.5, "cm"),
      legend.key.width = unit(0.3, "cm"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
      plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_colorbar(
      title = "t-value",
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0.5
    ))
  
  return(legend_plot)
  }
  
  
  
  
# Define which models to plot
model_list <- list(
  "Narrative details" = event.model,
  "Perceptual details" = visual.model,
  "Positive valence" = pos.model,
  "Negative valence" = neg.model
)

# Set output directory - UNCOMMENT FOR EXPORT

# Loop through all models and save LEFT BRAIN plots (NO LEGEND, NO CAPTION)
for (model_name in names(model_list)) {
  
  cat("Creating left brain plot for:", model_name, "\n")
  
  # Create left brain plot
  plot_obj <- create_left_brain_no_legend(model_list[[model_name]])
  
  # Create clean filename
  filename <- gsub(" ", "_", tolower(model_name))
  filepath <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(filename, '_left_brain_only_FOR_FIGURE_2.png'))
  
  # Save plot - 3 inches wide

    device = "png",

    height = 1.6,     # Adjust as needed
    units = "in",
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  cat("Saved:", filepath, "\n\n")
  
  # Display plot
  print(plot_obj)
  
  # Pause between saves
  Sys.sleep(0.5)
}
```
